title: Computational Methods & Problem-Solving Case Studies
summary: A quantitative problem-solving research programme that develops disciplined hypothesis formation, mathematical formalization, strategic reasoning, mathematics in finance, and reproducible computational analysis through source-grounded case studies and a gated Rust workbench. It includes the blocked Jane Street Pressure Points pilot and the admitted Finite-Binomial American Put first computational case. All software remains research-only, case-scoped, and independent of OFRL-IB-001.

release_readiness.independent_assurance_rationale: The current R1 scope remains analytical and RESEARCH_ONLY. The admitted Rust package is a case-specific research prototype using synthetic inputs; it is not released as a reusable pricing service, operational decision-support system, or trading component. No market data or live action is integrated. Reassess risk tier and independent assurance before any public reusable pricing or decision-support release.
